Travel under the waterfalls and into sea caves when conditions permit, encounter playful dolphins, turtles, whales (in season), and more. Dolphins skimming the waves before you is an experience to remember always. When conditions allow the raft will stop to swim or snorkel. services.desc: Trip Details Experience the majestic Na Pali coast, Kauai, on the custom-built catamaran "Lucky Lady". Snorkel, sail (conditions permitting), view towering sea cliffs, waterfalls, sea caves, pristine beaches, and remote wilderness coastline. Captains narrate Hawaiian history & legends. Encounter Spinner Dolphins, Turtles and Humpback Whale watching in season (Dec.-Apr.) Join us for the best day of your vacation! Snorkeling, waterslide fun, swim platform, spacious main deck, and observation deck. Equipped with two restrooms and freshwater showers. We provide quality gear, instruction, and safety snorkel vests. Menu Breakfast: Treats Lunch: Build your own sandwiches, Chips, Cookies & pasta

services.name: Luxury Nā Pali Sunset Experience aboard Lady Kailani
services.desc: Trip Details Join us on the Lucky Lady for 4.5 hours and experience the brilliance of a Hawaiian sunset at sea. Enjoy narration of Hawaiian history and legends from your certified Captain, and five star attention from our professional crew. A cruise up the Nā Pali Coast ~ There is no better way to spend an afternoon on Kauaʻi! The Lucky Lady, our largest vessel provides a variety of seating areas with an upper and lower deck and cabin for your safety, comfort, and fun. Come travel Kauai's magical coastline and encounter pods of playful dolphins, skimming the waters at our bows. Learn about the history and legends of Na Pali and the abundant marine life you encounter. Humpback whale watching

services.name: Express Nā Pali Sunset Tour aboard 'Imiloa
services.desc: Tour Description Wet, Wild & Wow! The Express Na Pali Sunset Tour is one of our favorites. A great way to see the Na Pali Coast for the first time. Enjoy panoramic view of the entire coastline. Every sunset experience is one of a kind. Cascading Waterfalls scattered throughout the peaks and valleys. Rainbows somehow are always just around the corner. Dress casually, be prepared, you will get wet! 'Imiloa is known for being one of the fastest & most adventurous boats on the Na Pali, cutting down the commute time to and from by an hour. We begin with a briefing & introduction as we depart from Port Allen, Kauai and head West, then North and upwind to the Na Pali (depending on the conditions).

services.name: Whale Watch Cocktail Tour - aboard 'Imiloa
services.desc: Trip Details Join us for a fun & adventure as we go whale watching along Kauai’s south shore to find the gentle giants of the sea. This popular Humpback Whale Watching tour is featured during the height of Hawaii’s Whale season (Dec. - March), it is a favorite among wildlife enthusiasts. Come dressed casually, bring a jacket or windbreaker, & be prepared to get wet! Hop aboard our Express catamaran. This vessel provides cushioned forward-facing seats, a shaded cabin, and 2 restrooms. >##Menu Light Snacks & Open Bar. Our crew members will be serving you at your seat. services.name: Nā Pali Raft Beach Landing
services.desc: Trip Details 6- 6 1/2 hour Ultimate Adventure Raft tour explores all the "nooks and crannies" of Na Pali...in all of its majesty! Under the waterfalls and into sea caves when conditions permit, encounter playful dolphins, turtles, famous movie locations, and more. We explore the coast and experience a very special cultural site. This is much more than your typical snorkel tour. Kauai Sea Tours is one of the only companies that has a special permit to land at Nualolo Kai, home to an ancient Hawaiian fishing village. A special permit is required. Passengers can take a guided cultural walk through the ancient village, enjoy great snorkeling, and a gorgeous beach! >##Menu Breakfast included
